help.title: «My Membership» Guide
help.intro: This page shows your professional membership journey step-by-step, from request to active card. Membership is not free; after identity verification, it is activated by paying from your wallet.

youCan.1: Apply for membership and select your field of expertise.
youCan.2: After identity verification, select a plan and make the payment.
youCan.3: View your active membership card and its expiration date.
youCan.4: Grant or revoke consent to display your profile in the member directory at any time.
youCan.5: If your membership expires, initiate the renewal process from this same page.

help.ifEmpty: If you have not yet registered a membership, you will see the «Membership Request» form — simply select your area of expertise and submit your request there.

sections.chain: The complete journey, from start to finish

chain.1: You submit a membership request (specifying an area of expertise is optional).
chain.2: The membership operator reviews and approves your identity.
chain.3: You select a plan and pay from your wallet.
chain.4: Your membership becomes active immediately and a membership card is issued.
chain.5: Near the end of the period, you will see a renewal reminder; if not renewed, there is a grace period followed by expiration.

grace.meaning: A short window immediately following membership expiration during which membership is still considered valid to give you time to renew.
